concurrency_scope: Initially two replay workers overlapped two native-control workers; after replay, at most two episode workers. One CUDA optimizer; latency runs serial after competing task work.
methods: Replay same saved inputs independently of autonomous trajectory comparisons. Per-state cosine signal/error coefficients are spatial, not temporal PSD. Same-RHS exact oracle uses separable eigenbasis and independently checks neighbor action. No spectral inverse or exact labels at inference.
latency_scope: Current paired serial CPU timings; ordinary desktop apps remain; first AI step excluded. Distinct from concurrent correctness wall time.
archive_policy: Git contains source/config/scalar receipts only; weights and raw states retained ignored under runs/. No final-scene data read before frozen eligibility.
